name: Position Size Calculator / Profit Calculator / Swap Calculator
summary: A suite of three calculator utilities for MetaTrader 5: a Position Size Calculator that determines optimal lot size based on risk percentage and stop-loss distance, a Profit Calculator that estimates potential profit or loss at a target price, and a Swap Calculator that forecasts overnight swap charges for holding positions. These tools assist traders in pre-trade planning and risk assessment without executing any trades.
summary_zh: 包含三个计算器工具的MetaTrader 5实用程序套件：仓位大小计算器根据风险比例和止损距离确定最佳手数，利润计算器估算目标价位潜在盈亏，掉期计算器预测持仓过夜的掉期费用。这些工具辅助交易者在交易前进行规划和风险评估，不会执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA套件不执行任何交易策略，而是一组纯计算工具。仓位大小计算器根据用户设定的风险比例（如账户净值的1%-2%）和止损点数来计算建议的手数，确保每笔交易的风险可控。利润计算器允许用户输入目标价位，计算在该价位平仓时的盈亏金额，帮助评估风险回报比。掉期计算器根据品种的掉期率和持仓方向预测隔夜持仓成本，辅助判断中长期持仓的可行性。这三个工具均不涉及自动入场或出场逻辑，也不执行任何订单操作。它们的核心价值在于帮助交易者在下单前进行定量分析，从而做出更理性的交易决策。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA suite does not execute any trading strategy; it is a set of pure calculation utilities. The Position Size Calculator determines the recommended lot size based on a user-defined risk percentage (e.g., 1-2% of account equity) and stop-loss distance in points, ensuring each trade's risk is controllable. The Profit Calculator allows users to input a target price and calculates the profit or loss if the position were closed at that level, helping evaluate the risk-reward ratio. The Swap Calculator forecasts overnight holding costs based on the instrument's swap rate and position direction, aiding decisions on medium-to-long-term position holding viability. None of these three tools involve automated entry or exit logic, nor do they execute any order operations. Their core value lies in helping traders perform quantitative analysis before placing orders, enabling more rational trading decisions. The suite serves as a pre-trade analysis companion rather than an automated trading system.

parameters.name: RiskPercentage
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险比例（账户净值的百分比）
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade (% of account equity)

parameters.name: TargetPrice
parameters.description: 目标平仓价格（利润计算器）

parameters.name: HoldingDays
parameters.description: 预计持仓天数（掉期计算器）

pros: 帮助交易者在下单前量化风险，避免过度仓位
三个计算器覆盖了交易规划的关键维度：仓位、盈亏、持仓成本
纯工具性质，不执行交易，不会因程序错误导致资金损失
操作简单直观，适合新手和有经验的交易者使用
可以显著提高交易纪律性，确保每笔交易风险在预设范围内
pros_en: Helps traders quantify risk before placing orders, preventing over-positioning
Three calculators cover the key dimensions of trade planning: position sizing, profit/loss, and holding costs
Pure utility nature with no trade execution eliminates risk of program errors causing financial loss
Simple and intuitive operation suitable for both novice and experienced traders
Significantly improves trading discipline by ensuring each trade's risk stays within predefined limits
cons: 不执行交易，无法自动执行风险管理，依赖交易者手动遵守计算结果
缺乏与市场实时状态的深度整合，如当前点差、滑点等实际执行因素
没有历史回测功能，无法验证基于这些计算的交易策略表现
各计算器之间缺少联动，例如仓位大小计算结果不能自动传递到利润计算器
界面可能较为简陋，缺少图形化展示如风险热力图或盈亏分布图
cons_en: Does not execute trades, so risk management depends entirely on the trader manually following calculated results
Lacks deep integration with real-time market conditions such as current spread, slippage, and other execution factors
No backtesting capability to validate trading strategies based on these calculations
Lacks linkage between calculators; for example, position size results cannot be automatically passed to the profit calculator
Interface may be rudimentary, missing graphical displays such as risk heat maps or P&L distribution charts
improvements: 增加计算器之间的数据联动，仓位大小结果自动填充到利润和掉期计算器
集成实时市场数据（点差、滑点）以提供更贴近实际的计算结果
improvements_en: Add data linkage between calculators so position size results auto-populate into profit and swap calculators
Integrate real-time market data (spread, slippage) to provide more realistic calculation results

risk_points: 纯工具性质，不涉及自动交易，但交易者可能过度依赖计算结果而忽视市场实际执行条件
掉期计算基于当前掉期率，但掉期率可能随时间变化，导致预测不准确
risk_points_en: Pure utility nature with no automated trading, but traders may over-rely on calculation results while neglecting actual market execution conditions
Swap calculations are based on current swap rates which may change over time, making forecasts inaccurate

These tools assist traders in pre-trade planning and risk assessment without executing any trades.
